commands.description: Echo a message (MCP-friendly leaf).
Print the program version.
Set up agent skills, MCP config, and app config for this app (binary via Homebrew).
commands.notes:
Set up agent artifacts after the binary is installed via Homebrew (see README for tap install).

Homebrew post_install runs:
  full-example configure --sync --yes

Interactive setup (per target):
  full-example configure

Upgrade:
  brew upgrade full-example

Shell completions are installed by Homebrew during brew install.
See: https://docs.brew.sh/Shell-Completion

See what is installed:
  full-example configure --status

Uninstall:
  brew uninstall <tap>/full-example

The formula uninstall hook runs `configure --remove-all --yes` (skills, MCP, and app config).

Remove app config only:
  full-example configure --remove-config --yes

Use --dry to preview changes without writing files.
Use --json for machine-readable output.

options.name: sync
options.description: Refresh installed skills, MCP, and config. Used by Homebrew post_install.

options.name: remove-all
options.description: Remove all detected agent artifacts (skills and MCP).

options.name: remove-config
options.description: Remove the app config file only.

options.name: dry
options.description: Show what would change without writing files.

options.name: json
options.description: Print changed paths or status JSON on stdout.

commands.description: Print resolved configuration value(s).
Write one configuration key to the config file.

options.name: from-env
options.description: Bind this key to its mapped environment variable (no literal value stored).

commands.description: Print bundled CLI documentation.
commands.notes: Topics print to stdout. Add --save to write files under ./docs/.

commands.description: Print README (user guide).
Print MCP server setup and tool guidance.
Print HTTP API setup and tool guidance.
Print the HTTP OpenAPI 3.1 document as JSON.
Print the full CLI command tree as JSON.
Print the full command reference as markdown.
Print a reference agent SKILL; run `configure` to install an optimized copy.
MCP server and bundle tools.
commands.notes:
Stdio MCP server. Add to Cursor, Claude Code, or Claude Desktop:

  command: full-example
  args: mcp

Or:

  full-example configure

Full setup guide: full-example docs mcp

commands.description: Pack dist MCP artifacts (`.mcpb`, Claude Code plugin zip) from dist/<key>.
HTTP API server for tools.
commands.notes:
HTTP tool server on http://127.0.0.1:3000.

Endpoints: GET /health, GET /openapi.json, GET /openapi-browser, POST /tools/:name

Configure app settings:

  full-example configure

Full setup guide: full-example docs http
